input.command:
python3 -c '
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0069.png")
# Find sofa bounding box
# Sofa color is slate blue/grey ~ [100-130, 110-140, 110-140] in BGR
mask = (img[:,:,0] > 90) & (img[:,:,0] < 130) & (img[:,:,1] > 100) & (img[:,:,1] < 140) & (img[:,:,2] > 100) & (img[:,:,2] < 140)
y_indices, x_indices = np.where(mask)
if len(x_indices) > 0:
    print(f"Sofa in obs 69: x=[{x_indices.min()}, {x_indices.max()}], y=[{y_indices.min()}, {y_indices.max()}]")
    print(f"Width: {x_indices.max() - x_indices.min() + 1} px")
'
